prompts.a:
Create a single full 16:9 pixel-art TITLE SCREEN BACKGROUND for BATTLE OF GODS, intended to be reduced to native960x540. The first reference is the three-option concept board: it contains A(top),B(middle),C(bottom). Rebuild ONE selected concept as a spacious full16:9 scene; do not recreate the board. Second reference gives King's approved identity, not a sprite-sheet output target.
Keep crisp expressive pixel illustration, strong dark outlines and clustered pixel shading, warm brown/ochre/olive and deep charcoal/navy. King is a compact chibi sword wielder: spiky dark hair, orange-red scarf, small cream armor plates, dark tunic/pants, brown gloves/boots, heavy silver sword. Large head/short body, anatomically connected hands, no realistic adult warrior. Anonymous old stone ruins, slightly angled top-down pixel-RPG view, no horizon. Quiet mystery and ordinary root-creature watchers; no named gods/bosses, spoilers or new story reveals.
IMPORTANT: absolutely NO text, no logos, no options, no letters A/B/C, no UI, no borders, no menus or duplicated characters. King complete body, about20–26percent of screen height, grounded safely with readable sword; scene light coherent. ONE STILL ARTWORK, no sprite-sheet or motion-blur walking effect.
Recreate A / THE QUIET BREACH: King at lower right, calmly standing facing an upright violet-blue magical breach between worn anonymous stone uprights, carrying his silver sword on his shoulder. A couple of small dark wooden Rootling shapes peeking from shadows beyond the portal. Broken stone approach with roots, restrained cold motes. Evoke anticipation, no battle, no revealed deity. Portal on right upper middle, King at lower right with space around both. Complete interesting courtyard depth, stable terrain.
